camera_limit: Prompt angles were increased to counter repeated flattening. Broad lids suggest rough ranges only; helmet tilt, noncircular drawing and stylization prevent calibration. No consistent 45-degree view or exact 15-degree increase is claimed.
dispatcher_system_prompt_override: Dispatch exactly one image_gen call with the supplied complete raw prompt verbatim. Only 2D drawn art is permitted; 3D art is prohibited. No images, previous conversation, memory, other tools, subagents or extra generations.

tool_input.prompt:
Draw a GRITTY 2D PAINTED RASTER GAME SPRITE. Build its colors from irregular fine broken clusters and scratches with softly stepped pixel-adjacent edges; broad dark ink-wash SHAPES under dry crumbly chalk brush marks. Heavy matte grain and rough old-paint wear, never smooth modeled shading or a dimensional toy. Combine Hollow Knight's giant head and tiny compact readable body with Diablo II's murky weathered earth palette. Mail is dark and economical with a few tiny interlocking broken rings. Avoid continuous black comic contours; colored brush marks define edges. This should be visibly much rougher and more textured than an animation cel while retaining simple cartoon masses.

ONLY HAND-DRAWN 2D ART. A single full-body game character on a charcoal-black square canvas with a small painted ground shadow. No 3D render, model, sculpt, miniature, photograph, glossy shader or smooth surface-lighting gradients.

Mood-board direction: Hollow Knight's economical large-head/tiny-body silhouette and darkness; Diablo II's grim earthy palette and rough worn materials; only a trace of Castle Crashers squat posing, with none of its bright colors or comedy. Sacred-horror references supply soot black, bone gray and dried red. Solemn, lonely, road-worn and quietly uncanny, still cute in structure. Use few light accents against large quiet dark shapes. Never cheerful, polished or heroic.

Guarin is a household knight from the Royans/Isere lands in a story set in 1101. ENORMOUS full-face greathelm, tiny broad body, stubby arms and legs, small squat rounded boots; helmet about half the character's total height before foreshortening. Face and eyes completely concealed. Wear a plain dull dark-gray iron barrel greathelm: unadorned level circular lid, two plain vertical rivet strips, one narrow black visor slit and small round breathing holes. Dark ring-mail shirt and short sleeves, ragged muted dried-wine scarf/short cape and matching ragged waist cloth, brown belt with plain rectangular buckle, brown gloves, taupe/brown forearm and shin wraps, short brown boots. Straight double-edged arming sword in viewer-left hand, disk pommel, straight crossguard, straight blade directed down across the front toward lower-right. Elongated taupe wooden kite shield at viewer-right, dull iron rim and one narrow faded wine-red panel. The greathelm is the deliberate anachronism. No extra helmet disks, hinges, ornament, armor, heraldry, garments or weapons.

Orthographic elevated isometric gameplay view facing diagonally lower-right. Very steep downward camera, 65 degrees above the ground: the upright helmet has a LEVEL flat circular lid, drawn as a DEEP ellipse; broad lid clearly visible, shoulder tops hidden behind it, tiny body and stubby legs foreshortened. Draw the helmet, shield rim and boot tops coherently from above. Small complete silhouette, generous empty border, no writing or panels. Muted soot gray, muddy taupe, dark dried-wine cloth, sparse chalk-gray edges.
